faq.fallback_1_question: How do I book a ride?
faq.fallback_1_answer: Set your pickup and destination on the home screen, choose a vehicle, and confirm your fare.
faq.fallback_2_answer: Fares combine a base fare with distance and time charges, shown before you confirm the ride.
faq.fallback_3_answer: Yes. You can cancel from the ride screen; cancellation fees may apply after the driver departs.
faq.fallback_4_question: How do I add a payment method?
faq.fallback_4_answer: Open Wallet from Settings and top up, or add a payout method from your profile.
faq.fallback_5_question: How do I report a lost item?
faq.fallback_5_answer: Go to Settings → Lost Items and report it against the ride; the driver is notified immediately.
faq.fallback_6_answer: Yes. Your data is encrypted and shared with drivers only as needed for your ride.
